title: Plaid dollhouse
content: This random plaid dollhouse showed up randomly in my dream like a glitch. I peered inside and found it weird. Has anyone else seen this structure and what is it for? Is it a level in backrooms? Is it a dream glitch? Or is it a trap in mall world? Fyi I was also too big to fit in it like it was a toddler size dollhouse to play in. I got gutsy and climbed inside but the entire back wall was covered in cobwebs so I wussed out. I almost got stuck sliding in on my back. Never again plz
